LanguageData.Dungeon.label: dungeon entrance
LanguageData.Dungeon.description: There was once an underground civilization living deep below the surface. But they are all gone now. What happened to them? Who knows, but one thing is certain: they left a lot of loot down there.\n\nBuild a tunnel leading to a vast network of dungeons hidden below the surface and scavenge their treasures.

LanguageData.DungeonUpgrade.label: dungeon upgrade
LanguageData.DungeonUpgrade.description: Set up a keg filled with beer, mixed with a little go-juice and sprinkled with crushed wake-up.\n\nThis building passively increases the speed at which pawns can clear a dungeon, as they take a sip before entering. It must be placed directly adjacent to a dungeon entrance. The bonus applies only once per dungeon entrance; multiple upgrades do not stack.
LanguageData.UnfinishedTreasureMap.label: dungeon map
LanguageData.UnfinishedTreasureMap.description: This unfinished item tracks a pawn's dungeon progress from 0% to 100%, so the pawn does not have to start over after interrupting a scavenging bill. Canceling this item resets the pawn's dungeon progress.
